intro: Create a notebook to organize your work. No model is needed to get started.
name: Notebook name
required: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
empty: You do not have any notebooks yet.
consent: I authorize this verified local package to run. Changes to its files will require renewed authorization.
apiBlocked: Configure the provider and model below. API calls require consent for each notebook and provider.
engineHelp: Choose engine-manifest.json in the Windows x64 package folder. All files will be verified before execution.
changed: Review the package fingerprint before authorizing.

sources.title: Sources
sources.help: Highlight items in Zotero, then preview the selection. Including navigation selections is optional and can include an entire library.
sources.include_selected_containers: Include selected libraries, collections and saved searches
sources.provenance: Marked AI artifacts are excluded. Origin cannot be verified for unmarked notes or annotations. Review provenance, especially text copied from removed sources; these remain notes or annotations, not scientific publications.
sources.invalidYear: Enter years from 1 to 9999, with minimum no greater than maximum.
sources.previewAgain: Selection options changed. Preview again before capturing.
sources.duplicates: Possible duplicate DOI groups; items remain separate
sources.frozen: A snapshot freezes membership and version references. It is not a full PDF backup; an old PDF cannot be reopened if it no longer exists.
sources.external: Add or link external documents through Zotero first. Evidra does not search your disk for documents.
sources.changed: Zotero sources or notebook scope changed. Preview again or recheck source access.
sources.revoked: Source access removed from every snapshot in this notebook. Previously exported or sent data cannot be recalled. Recheck access to view remaining sources.

reasons.content_excluded: Content excluded by type, opt-in or AI provenance

sources.captureUncertain: The capture result is unknown. Retry the original capture to confirm its result.

evidence.help: Index the authorized PDFs, abstracts, notes or annotations. Search stays local and requires no model.
evidence.invalidLimits: Enter finite limits within the displayed bounds.
evidence.uncertain: The indexing result is unknown. Repeat the original request to recover its result.
evidence.empty: No matching excerpts in this snapshot.
evidence.label: Page label
evidence.pageOnly: Exact highlighting is unavailable. The page opens and the original excerpt remains here.
evidence.region: Optional region in PDF coordinates: left, bottom, right, top
evidence.previewHelp: Blank region uses the full visible page. Preview stays local; no model receives this image.
evidence.previewLimits: Preview limits: 16 million pixels, 600 kB encoded PNG; reduce scale or region when prompted.
evidence.ocr: Provide a searchable PDF in Zotero, then reindex. This version does not run OCR.
evidence.unsupported: This content kind is not indexed by this version.

reasons.PREVIEW_EVICTED: The reconstructible preview was evicted by the cache limit. Render it again.
reasons.ENGINE_RESTARTED: Engine restarted; start a new operation
reasons.INVALID_DOCUMENT_TYPE: The attachment does not have a PDF header
reasons.DOCUMENT_FILE_ERROR: The local file could not be opened safely
reasons.REPARSE_POINT: Linked or redirected file paths are blocked
reasons.NOT_REGULAR_FILE: The attachment is not a regular file
reasons.INVALID_DOCUMENT_PATH: The local attachment path is invalid
reasons.PARSER_FAILED: The PDF parser failed; inspect or replace this file
reasons.PARSER_PROCESS_ERROR: The isolated parser could not start
reasons.PARSER_PROTOCOL: The parser did not return a complete valid result
reasons.PARSER_LIMIT_SETUP: The worker limits could not be verified
reasons.PARSER_DIAGNOSTIC: The parser reported an unexpected diagnostic
reasons.PARSER_CLEANUP_FAILED: The owned parser did not exit
reasons.DOCUMENT_SUPERVISOR_FAILED: The document operation could not finalize; inspect the local engine log
reasons.READER_SIZE_MISMATCH: The loaded Reader PDF has a different size
reasons.READER_VERSION_MISMATCH: The loaded Reader PDF differs from this evidence
reasons.READER_PDF_UNAVAILABLE: This Reader view does not expose a PDF document
reasons.READER_CHANGED: The active Reader view changed; open the excerpt again
reasons.READER_TIMEOUT: The Reader did not become ready within 10 seconds
reasons.READER_NOT_READY: The requested Reader tab is unavailable
reasons.INVALID_PAGE: The physical page does not exist
reasons.INVALID_REGION: The region is invalid or outside the visible page
reasons.SOURCE_REVOKED: This source is no longer authorized
reasons.UNAUTHENTICATED: The engine session is not authenticated
reasons.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The request key belongs to different parameters
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT: This content kind is not supported for this action
reasons.TEXT_LIMIT: The text exceeds the bounded unpaginated unit size. Increase the parser memory limit before reindexing.
reasons.INVALID_TEXT_RECEIPT: The native text receipt did not verify
reasons.BODY_TOO_LARGE: The result exceeds the display channel limit
reasons.file_changed: The attachment file changed. Reindex the current authorized version.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_FORMAT: This text format, encoding or EPUB feature is unsupported. No full-text coverage was published.
reasons.TEXT_ENCODING_ERROR: The original file bytes cannot be decoded as valid text using the supported encoding.
reasons.INVALID_TEXT_DOCUMENT: The textual attachment is malformed or has invalid EPUB members.
reasons.INCOMPLETE_TEXT: An EPUB spine unit has no extractable text. Full-text coverage is unavailable.

evidence.textOnly: Text precision: the excerpt is verified against the stored original text. Opening textual attachments at a verified native location is not available; open the attachment from Zotero to inspect the file.
